name: app-blurred-silhouette-with-frosted-glucose-metric-tiles
title: Glucose Metric Tiles over a Blurred Silhouette
whatItIs: A blurred duotone silhouette of a person looking at a phone with five soft gradient widgets floating in front: Average Glucose in a rose gradient, Time in Range with a slider, Variability with a magenta glow, Vitamin D in blue and Spikes in orange with a blue blob.
whatItMeans: Soft radial gradients inside each tile make health numbers feel calm and organic, and the blurred person gives human context.
techniques: Radial gradient glow inside each tile
Bento of one wide and four small tiles
Simple white labels and big numerals

vocabulary.definition: A small tile whose colour is a soft radial blend.
A defocused figure used as a background.
